meta.name: No Good Deed
meta.description:
The sale of Paul and Lydia's picture-perfect LA home forces them to face painful family secrets — and hide them from prying eyes and cutthroat buyers.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: Open House
videos.overview: Paul and Lydia clash over their future and fend off blackmail threats as they watch potential buyers tour their painstakingly renovated Los Feliz home.

videos.title: Private Showing
videos.overview: As Lydia's second thoughts send Paul scrambling, she shares an emotional moment — and advice — with Sarah. Margo attempts to mix business with pleasure.

videos.title: Letters of Intent
videos.overview: Lydia and Paul disagree on how to handle Mikey. Carla discovers just how close Dennis is to his mom. Leslie and Sarah run up against some harsh truths.

videos.title: Foundation Issues
videos.overview: Lydia's actions force Paul to face memories he'd rather forget, Margo schemes to salvage things with JD, and Carla puts the brakes on Denise's big plans.

videos.title: Off the Market
videos.overview: When the for-sale sign comes down, the stakes go up. As Leslie and Sarah lurk, Margo and JD try to edge out the competition by cozying up to the Morgans.

videos.title: Full Disclosure
videos.overview: While Paul helps Nate look for Mikey, Lydia plays hardball. Making nice becomes a labor of love for Carla. Shocking discoveries shake two marriages.

videos.title: Best and Final
videos.overview: Rumors about the house push Paul to cut a deal as Lydia faces the music. JD reels from Margo's lies. Carla can't bear to hide a huge secret from Dennis.

videos.title: Sold
videos.overview: Paul and Lydia argue over next steps, family revelations rock Dennis' world, and an offhand comment leads to a damning new clue — and a path to closure.
